versions.short: The bill would set national rules for college sports, covering protections for student athletes (including their rights to earn money from their name, image, and likeness, transfer and eligibility rules, medical coverage, safety standards, and an ombudsman office), changes to agent and endorsement contract rules, limits on how schools and conferences handle payments to athletes, a commission to study the future of college athletics, rules for college sports broadcasting and media rights, and a grant program to improve broadband and sports media infrastructure at historically Black colleges and universities.
